name: The Muse
source:
You're an artist with artist's block. Nothing seems to inspire you anymore. Until, that is, a cute, pink bunny girl suddenly appears in your studio, asking you to draw her.

Do you do as she says? Or continue to struggle finding that spark?

[From [url=https://spoonycatt.itch.io/the-muse]Itch.io[/url]]
